coordinateConvention: half-open native pixels; visible wings and tail included
measurement: libvpx-vp9 RGBA alpha > 16; newly accepted reading scanned through all 240 frames, previous hash-bound measurements retained.
intervalDefinition: intersection over every frame with potentially visible frost of [left - .5 * bodyWidth, rightExclusive + .5 * bodyWidth]; runs additionally retain all-frame bounds and exact effect frame ranges

media.timingNote: Accepted 10-second local retimed candidate; 24fps output, not a claim of 240 original AI frames.
